lines.text: You held us up Through every storm
When we need it now this room feels thin
for you and time feels cruel and empty
But I know like always you will fight
Stronger than anyone I know or anyone can imagine
Over 20 years together remaining so close never breaking your time together
What you share is true love
And it will never leave you
we will not move we will hold you up
If your voice falls quiet Speak for you
Take this love Like a light in the dark
the time he was there for you
You never imagined you would have to face
Learning to live Without him by your side
with you and he is right
